description: After a booking is successfully saved, show a confirmation popup (AlertDialog) with two options: 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' (sends a professional email to the client with booking details) and 'Save without Sending' (closes normally). Uses the existing send-client-email Supabase edge function.
steps: In src/components/dashboard/new-booking-dialog.tsx, add a new state variable (e.g., `showAckDialog`) and a `savedBookingData` ref/state to hold the form values after successful save.

Modify the `onSuccess` callback of the `submit` mutation: instead of immediately closing the dialog and resetting the form, set `showAckDialog = true` and store the booking details (client_name, email_id, plan_name, booking_id, invoice_number, amount_received, total_amount, payment_mode_ref, business_name, date) in state.

Create a new component (PaymentAcknowledgmentDialog or inline AlertDialog) that renders when `showAckDialog` is true. It should show: Title: 'Booking Saved Successfully', Description: 'Would you like to send a payment acknowledgment email to the client?', Two buttons: 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' (primary action) and 'Save without Sending' (cancel/outline).

Implement the 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' button handler: call `supabase.functions.invoke('send-client-email', { body: { to: savedBookingData.email_id, subject: 'Payment Acknowledgment - [booking_id]', html: professionalEmailTemplate, text: plainTextVersion } })`. Show toast on success/failure. Then close the ack dialog, close the main booking dialog, and reset the form.
Implement the 'Save without Sending' button handler: close the ack dialog, close the main booking dialog, and reset the form (same as current onSuccess behavior).

Create a professional HTML email template for the payment acknowledgment. Include: company branding (EaseMyOffice), client name, booking ID, plan name, invoice number, amount received, payment mode, date, and a thank-you message. Style it inline for email compatibility.
If the client email (email_id) is empty, skip showing the popup entirely and just close normally (current behavior) since there is no email to send to.
Disable the 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' button while the email is being sent (add a sending state), show a loading indicator.
acceptance_criteria: After clicking Save Booking and the booking saves successfully, if email_id is filled, a popup appears with 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' and 'Save without Sending' options
Clicking 'Send Payment Acknowledgment' invokes the send-client-email edge function with a properly formatted HTML email containing booking details
Clicking 'Save without Sending' closes the dialog without sending email (same as old behavior)
If email_id is empty, the dialog closes immediately without showing the popup (old behavior preserved)
The email template includes: client name, booking ID, plan name, invoice number, amount received, payment mode, and date
Success/error toasts are shown for both the email send result and the booking save
TypeScript compiles without errors (bunx tsc --noEmit passes)
Full build succeeds (bun run build passes)
verification: Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` and confirm zero errors
Run `bun run build` and confirm successful build with no errors
findings: Implementation completed successfully. TypeScript compilation and full Vite build both pass with zero errors. Used standard Button components instead of AlertDialogAction/AlertDialogCancel to have more control over async behavior (disable while sending). The AlertDialog is controlled via open prop tied to showAckDialog state.
